context: Sho and Hina work on a math worksheet together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひな、宿題、一緒に、しよう。
lines.en: Hina, let's do our homework together.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely warm opening. Quiet six-year-old voice, no performance. A small invitation offered without expectation. Steady pace, almost gentle.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah — I'm going to try my best.
lines.style: Bright child's voice, full of simple commitment. No hesitation. Natural enthusiasm, not performed. Quick, willing energy threading through.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine triumph. Quick uptake on the realization. Quiet pride in the voice — not loud, but real. Slightly faster pace on the discovery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Immediate, genuine admiration. High, engaged child's voice. Quick and interested, leaning forward in attention. No performative flattery — she means it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft and philosophical for a six-year-old. Quiet contentment underneath. Small warmth settling in. Slower, reflective pace. The ease of someone who has figured something out.
